records.text: Owens said Haim Braverman plotted her assassination after becoming radicalized in a 26-member group chat, and that the FBI arrested him before he pleaded guilty and was imprisoned.

verification.notes: DOJ records confirm that Haim Braverman transmitted explicit death threats, including a group-chat message, was investigated by the FBI, and pleaded guilty in federal court. Public records reviewed do not confirm that radicalization occurred inside a 26-member chat; an earlier Owens transcript instead described 39 other participants. The current DOJ page announces a scheduled sentencing but does not establish the episode's claim that he had already been sentenced and imprisoned. The threats, federal case, and guilty plea are supported; the participant count, causal framing, and completed-imprisonment claim are not fully established.
